how: We read the website of every Miami wedding photographer listed on Lazo (219 listings, 168 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a Portland studio and a France-based photographer listed with Miami addresses, a national chain with a landing page per city, and studios whose sites say nothing specific about how they work. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Have you shot in Miami's summer heat and afternoon rain, and how do you handle portraits when the ceremony is outdoors at 4 p.m. in August?
Can I see a full gallery from one wedding at a venue like mine, not just the highlights?
What is the delivery timeline, and is a second shooter included or an add-on?

picks.name: Enamorado Photographers
picks.blurb: Miguel and Mele are a husband-and-wife documentary team who photograph weddings the way they remember them, one of them beside you and the other in the next room catching what you did not pose for. They do not publish a full price list; every wedding is a custom proposal sized to your actual day.

picks.name: Simply Captivating Photography
picks.blurb: A husband-and-wife-led photo and video team that has documented South Florida weddings for over twenty years, from Central Florida to the Keys. Simply Captivating publishes its starting collections and describes its style as quiet luxury and real emotion.

picks.name: Photography by Santy Martinez
picks.blurb: Over a decade of weddings in Miami, Broward and Palm Beach, led by Santy with Annie alongside. Photography by Santy Martinez works in a creative, authentic style and shows wedding video highlights on the site as well as stills.

picks.name: Deivis Archbold Photography
picks.blurb: Keyla and Deivis Archbold are a Fort Lauderdale husband-and-wife team whose photography began with the anticipation of their first child; their wedding work leans high-fashion and glamour. Collections start at $3,995 and the site asks you to inquire early because dates are limited.

picks.name: Lenisse Komatsu Photography
picks.blurb: Lenisse Komatsu has photographed over 500 weddings across Miami, Fort Lauderdale and Palm Beach in a style she describes as timeless elegance with candid storytelling. Her pricing page leads with why experience matters on a day with no second chances.

picks.name: Ambrosio Photography
picks.blurb: Twenty years of blending into the background: Stacey Ambrosio's pitch is that the best wedding photos happen when you forget the camera is there. Classic portraits and real emotion for weddings in Miami, Palm Beach and Boca Raton, with collections listed on the site.

picks.name: Isabel Photography
picks.blurb: Shooting weddings since 2006, Isabel keeps the approach simple: capture the day as it happens, stage only the formals and family sessions, and blend in. Based in Sunny Isles Beach, she works South Florida, New York City and destinations.

picks.name: PS Photography and Films
picks.blurb: Eighteen years of balancing editorial elegance with an intimate photojournalistic style, as PS Photography and Films puts it. A Coral Gables photo and video team specializing in luxury weddings, chasing light and love across the globe.

picks.name: La Vie Studios
picks.blurb: A collective of photographers, videographers and editors based in Miami, making fun, romantic and cinematic images for couples around the world. La Vie Studios lists its base collections and what they include on the site, with a full quote on request.

picks.name: Couture Bridal Photography
picks.blurb: Alfredo Valentine has been a destination wedding photographer since 2008, after learning the craft on film as a teenager in Queens. Couture Bridal Photography serves South Florida, the Caribbean and Central and South America in an editorial, timeless style and publishes its investment options.

picks.name: Alessandro Fanghella Photography
picks.blurb: Alessandro Fanghella describes himself as a calm presence who does not treat a wedding as a production or a checklist of images, and who helps couples move through the day with ease. South Florida weddings and engagements, documented with intention rather than a shot list.

picks.name: Evan Rich Photography
picks.blurb: Evan Rich Photography promises photographers with a plan in place who will communicate kindly with you, your planner and your demanding Aunt Sally. Serving Miami, the Florida Keys, Palm Beach, New York and destinations, with real weddings from Capri to Ocean Reef on the site.
